prompt:
Asset type: ONE clean 2D cutout puppet texture atlas for a continuously rigged desktop pet, NOT a sprite animation sheet.
The attached three-view image is the identity reference. Simplify THIS same adult chibi dragon girl into clean cel-shaded anime art: silver-white wavy long hair, violet eyes, pale segmented curved dragon horns, pointed ears, braided silver knot ornament and tassel, little lavender bat wings, thick curled white scaled tail, opaque white off-shoulder fantasy dress, white shoes. Keep the same recognizable cute head proportions and colors. Reduce tiny lace, jewelry, hair strands and scales into large readable shapes. Crisp thin muted-lavender outlines, flat color fills and ONE soft shadow tone, no texture, no hatching, no pixel noise, no bloom, no soft brush fuzz.
ALL PARTS IN THIS ATLAS ARE FRONT VIEW, looking directly toward viewer. We will assemble them with code. Each item is an isolated detached illustrated puppet PART, never a complete full-body character. No assembled figure anywhere.
STRICT 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS (16 cells), square 2048x2048 canvas preferred. Exactly ONE specified PART per cell; parts stay inside central70% of cell with substantial empty transparent padding. Same coherent drawing style. No labels, text, cell borders, shadows, background, checkerboard, fragments or noise. Actual RGBA TRANSPARENT alpha outside each illustrated part. All shapes complete, no clipped points, connection ends rounded and overlapping for joints.
Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom, EXACT ordering:
Row1 cell1: BACK HAIR only, a thick silver-white long wavy hair curtain from crown down to thighs, no face/body/ears/horns, broad clean locks.
Row1 cell2: HEAD only, chibi head with pale horns, pointed ears, white bangs/crown hair and braided silver knot+tassel on viewer RIGHT, smooth pale BLANK FACE with no eyes, no eyebrows and NO MOUTH (these are separate parts). Neck stub at bottom. No long back hair.
Row1 cell3: WHITE BODICE / TORSO only from neck/chest down to waist, opaque modest off-shoulder white dress top with simple silver center ornament. No head, arms, skirt or legs. Complete shoulder attachment areas.
Row1 cell4: SKIRT only, a white asymmetric knee-length skirt with 3 broad overlapping pointed panels, soft pale lavender underside, waist attachment at top. No torso, legs, tail or shoes. Simplified from original white gown.
Row2 cell1: character's LEFT ARM with broad white flowing sleeve and small relaxed hand together as one part, shoulder attachment at top, fingers at bottom. No torso.
Row2 cell2: character's RIGHT ARM/sleeve/hand matching the other part.
Row2 cell3: LEFT UPPER LEG only, simple pale smooth thigh, rounded hip and knee connection ends; no shoe or clothing, neutral anatomy diagram part.
Row2 cell4: RIGHT UPPER LEG matching.
Row3 cell1: LEFT LOWER LEG with white ankle-strap shoe attached, from knee joint to complete foot/sole, FRONT facing; no upper thigh.
Row3 cell2: RIGHT LOWER LEG/shoe matching.
Row3 cell3: LEFT WING only, small pale lavender bat dragon wing with clear silver ribs, shoulder attachment on inner edge. Complete outline.
Row3 cell4: RIGHT WING only matching.
Row4 cell1: TAIL only, one thick white scaled dragon tail curled in a gentle C shape, broad root attachment at upper left and tapered tip, simplified large scale shapes, no body/hair.
Row4 cell2: a matched PAIR OF OPEN ANIME EYES with thin brows and violet irises, separated by transparent gap, FRONT view. No face, nose, skin patch or hair.
Row4 cell3: one tiny OPEN MOUTH shape, soft pink oval with thin muted-lavender outline, no face/skin/teeth. Can be vertically compressed for closed mouth.
Row4 cell4: FRONT SIDELOCKS only, two long narrow silver-white wavy hair locks hanging either side of face/chest with transparent central gap. No face/body/bangs.
THIS IS 16 SEPARATE CUTOUT PARTS, not16 characters. Each part's complete painted silhouette surrounded by real transparent pixels, without any detached debris.
